## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4 (retraction): COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md documents Jira-Ticket and DSO-Task git trailer behavior — DD4 is retracted because dependency story cab1-600f (git trailers) was deleted/archived before implementation. No trailer injection code exists in the codebase. Documentation of a non-existent feature would be misleading.

## Description

The completion verifier flagged DD4 as FAIL: COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md does not document Jira-Ticket/DSO-Task trailer behavior. This is correct — story cab1-600f (which would have implemented trailer injection) was deleted before implementation. There is no trailer code to document.

### Action required

1. Add a comment to COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md noting the planned trailer feature is deferred (not silently omitted):

In plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md, in the commit message section, add a note:
```
<!-- Future: Jira-Ticket and DSO-Task git trailers (from cab1-600f) are planned
     but not yet implemented. When implemented, this section will document:
     - Jira-Ticket: populated from .tickets-tracker/<task_id>/SYNC* jira_key field
     - DSO-Task: populated from active session task ID
     - Trailers omitted (not errored) when source unavailable -->
```

2. Add a ticket comment on ed9c-a277 documenting the scope retraction:
```
SCOPE_RETRACTION: DD4 (COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md trailer documentation) is retracted.
Dependency story cab1-600f (git trailer injection) was deleted/archived before implementation.
No Jira-Ticket or DSO-Task trailer code exists. DD4 will be re-activated when a future
story implements trailer injection (see planned feature note added to COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md).
```

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5 || true
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md has the future feature note about trailers
  Verify: grep -q "cab1-600f\|Jira-Ticket.*planned\|trailer.*planned" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] SCOPE_RETRACTION comment on ticket ed9c-a277
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show ed9c-a277 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); found=[c for c in d.get('comments',[]) if 'SCOPE_RETRACTION' in c.get('body','')]; exit(0 if found else 1)"
data.title: Retract ed9c-a277 DD4: acknowledge cab1-600f trailer story was deleted before implementation
